score_basis: 7 graded events (6 in-window + 1 outside_window per Rule 7); recency weights 7..1; Q1 FY27 pending and Q3 FY25 not_retrieved, both excluded. Grades most-recent-first: 2,1,1,1,1,1,2. (36/28) x 5 = 6.43.
note: Standard mode: quarterly calls Q2 FY25-Q1 FY27. Q1 FY27 transcript read in full (azad.in PDF). Q1 FY26 and Q2 FY26 read from azad.in PDFs via tool extraction (Q1 is OCR text). Q3 FY26 (NSE archive), Q4 FY26 (financialfilings.com mirror), Q2 FY25 (NSE archive) and Q4 FY24 (BSE) read via model-extracted text; Q4 FY25 via AlphaStreet auto-generated transcript with garbled figures (gross debt 'INR2243 crores'). All quotes near-verbatim; re-verify against PDFs before quoting as exact. Basis: standalone unless stated; calls often do not label basis. Pattern: headline revenue-growth and EBITDA-margin guidance met or beaten every year (FY25 +32.9% vs 25-30%; FY26 +30.3% standalone vs 25-30%/30%+; margins 35.5-37.6% vs 33-35% guide). Timeline, capacity-ramp and working-capital promises slip repeatedly: indigenous turbojet engine promised 'very soon' (May-25), '2 engines in FY26' (Aug-25), 'a couple of months' (Nov-25), Q3-Q4 FY26 with 'I don't see any more delays' (Feb-26), delivered 22 Jul 2026; working-capital normalisation moved from FY26 (Nov-24, May-25, Feb-26) to H1/H2 FY27, with the H2 FY27 target relaxed from 140-150 to 160-180 days; new-facility utilisation 70%+ by end FY26 (May-25) became 'FY26 stabilisation year', ramp from Q3 FY27; dedicated-plant count behind the 8-in-12-18-months plan (4 by Apr 2026, remaining 4 'this financial year'); Saudi/Baker Hughes timelines 'shifted' with no new date. Reasons were given for most slips (customer qualification cycles, MoD testing, bill-discounting set-up). 'Major issue' test: no item would be a Severe forensic flag; no grade-0 override. Not retrieved: Q3 FY25 call transcript (not on stockanalysis.com index, not found on AlphaStreet/Quartr after 2 attempts); FY26 actual capex vs Rs450 Cr plan; Siemens H2 FY26 revenue contribution; FY26 subsidiary-level PAT; Q2 FY27 outcomes (Rolls-Royce qualification batch, H1 FY27 inventory days, weapon testing) - Q2 FY27 results due ~Nov 2026. Rule 6: Reg 30 boilerplate and undated aspirations (TAM, wallet share) skipped. Rule 7: 25-30% growth guide traced to Q4 FY24 call (2024-05-22).
